newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: BBAG says Martfu/Sopron share swap agreed at 5:4.
newsitem.headline: BBAG says Martfu/Sopron share swap agreed at 5:4.

text.p: Austrian beverage company BBAG Oesterreichische Brau-Beteiligungs-AG on Monday offered the holders of five ordinary shares in Hungarian brewery Martfu four ordinary shares in Sopron.
BBAG holds a majority stake in the two Hungarian breweries, which it last month decided to merge, through its fully-owned Austrian brewery Brau-Union Goess-Reininghaus-Oesterreichische Brau AG.
The merger would raise Sopron's base capital through the issue of 856,800 ordinary shares with a nominal value of 1,000 forints, BBAG said in a statement.
The supervisory boards of the two Hungarian breweries supported the share swap proposal, BBAG said.
The final decision over the merger and the share swap would be made at the shareholders' meetings of Martfu and Sopron on April 24 and 25, respectively. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 256
